_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light.
To us a child is born.
The grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all.
To us a child is born.
Glory to God in the highest, and peace on earth.
Come, let us adore him. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: It is night, and the fields are cold, and ordinary people are keeping watch.
Glory to God in the highest!
Suddenly the dark is torn open with light, and the sky is loud with song.
Glory to God in the highest!
To you is born this day a Savior — wrapped in cloth, laid in a feeding trough.
Glory to God in the highest!
The great light has come to the smallest place; God is here, and God is for us.
Glory to God in the highest, and peace on earth!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: A great light for those in darkness; to us a child is born.
Glory to God in the highest!
Grace has appeared, a Savior in a manger.
Glory to God in the highest!
God comes to the smallest place; come, adore him.
Glory to God in the highest! Amen.
